name: S.A.S. Dragon Holdings Limited
summary: S.A.S. Dragon Holdings Limited, an investment holding company, provides electronic supply chain services in Hong Kong, Mainland China, Taiwan, the United States, Vietnam, Singapore, Macao, and internationally. It focuses on the design, development, sourcing, quality assurance, and logistics management of electronic components and semiconductors products, including chipset solutions, display panels, memory chips, light-emitting diode (LED) lighting solutions, power supply system solutions, multimedia system solutions, PEMCO, IoT home automation solutions, and other premier solutions.
